about: Bioassay instruments (plate reader, plate washer, real-time PCR, SPR, ITC, flow cytometer): load the consumable, set the assay method, start the run as a job, read the record, evaluate it.

declined_secondary.thermo_ibrightfl1500: gel / blot imaging: the imaging class covers its exposures and images; it runs no plate assay
declined_secondary.biorad_miniprotean: gel electrophoresis: the chromatography class covers it (method / start / stop of the power supply)
declined_secondary.eppendorf_cellxpertc170i: cell-culture incubation is temperature / gas control (thermal class); it loads no assay consumable and keeps no run record
declined_secondary.wtw_oxitopi: BOD bottles measured by pressure heads: the thin class covers its start / result; no plate, chip or tube to load

unsupported.method: a Biacore run takes its method when it starts

alternatives.method: give the method with start: `chemlab run INST start RUN samples=R1B1,R1B2 contact=120s dissociation=600s flow=30uL/min path=1-2 ref=2-1 rate=10`, or cycles=@cycles.json

load: ITEM is the new chip id; --type is the chip type (CM5, SA, NTA, ...); it waits until the chip is docked (about a minute)
start: RUN is the new run id; method keys: samples= contact= dissociation= flow= regen= regen-contact= startup= path= ref= rate= detection= (or cycles=@file.json); the sample rack must be inside
data: without --cycle: the report points of the run; with --cycle N --curves 2-1: that cycle's sensorgram
analyze: models: kinetics, affinity, concentration, solvent-correction; keys: cycles=3,4,5 subtraction=2-1 blanks=2 concs=0,2nM,4nM

manual.*: Biacore T200 instrument handbook 28976883 pp. 44-59 (operation); getting started 28-9768-63 pp. 33-45 (dock chip, prime, temperature); software handbook 28-9768-78 pp. 79-107 (methods), pp. 109-125 (evaluation)

unsupported.prime: no fluid lines to prime; the cell and syringe are cleaned with the wash module

alternatives.prime: clean with the wash module: `chemlab call INST cleaning_tool.insert`, then `chemlab call INST clean.start ...`

load: --into cell (default; 300 uL, rinsed first unless --no-rinse) or --into syringe (from a 60 uL tube). The syringe ends in the cell when both are loaded, in either order. It moves the syringe and waits for each step (a few minutes for the syringe).
method: injection duration left out: volume / 0.5 uL/s (the contract example: 2 uL in 4 s)
analyze: MODEL is the fitting model (one_set_of_sites, two_sets_of_sites, ...); keys: exclude=1 cell=0.1mM syringe=1mM
